notes: Card flags the pole broad; top peaks are e-pieces ('ete' x4, 'ce', 'e', 'BE', 'LE', 'SE'), so 'ete' is a sub-trigger of a wider 'e-piece continuing a word' pattern. Probes: 'ete' 0.83-1.0, 'LE' in capitals 0.68. Near misses keep the letters e-t-e inside whole tokens (athlete, complete, concrete, Crete).
